summary: Published src/content/blog/beginner/fate-line-starting-points.md, a focused companion to fate-line.md following the established variation-article pattern (fate-line-branches-meaning.md, no-fate-line-meaning.md). Covers only the four starting points approved repository evidence establishes -- wrist/base, Mount of Luna, life line, mid-palm/later -- grounded in lessons/lines/05-fate-line.mdx and fate-line.md. The Mount of Luna section keeps Benham's historical opposite-sex formulation, Cheiro's outside-approval reading, and West's broader contemporary extension explicitly distinct rather than merged into one consensus claim. Added one reciprocal link from fate-line.md's starting-point subsection and updated the canonical docs.
